_reference_channel_note: Set this to a YouTube channel whose style you want to mimic. Current: New Rockstars — superhero breakdowns, fights, crossovers, powers explained. Other options: @marvelentertainment, @dccomics, @screencrush
_voice_id_note: Paid library voice (better quality, requires paid plan): BlgEcC0TfWpBak7FmvHW. Free voice (Roger, works on free plan): CwhRBWXzGAHq8TQ4Fs17
_visual_video_provider_note: Choose 'kling' for the Kling API, 'runpod' for LTX-Video RunPod server, or 'minimax_h3' for MiniMax H3 (best quality, 15s clips, 768p).
_visual_prompt_mode_note: narration = YouTube essay style (TTS voice + cinematic b-roll). cinematic = movie/anime style (H3 native voice, character dialogue, screenplay format, no TTS).
_script_duration_note: Target script duration in minutes. Word counts are derived at 150 WPM. e.g. 1 min = ~150 words, 3 min = ~450 words, 5 min = ~750 words, 10 min = ~1500 words.
_script_style_note: Writing style: cinematic_storytelling (superhero), kids_rhyming (nursery), educational, documentary
_weekly_schedule_note: When batch_size=7, videos are auto-scheduled Mon-Sun at publish_time_utc (24h format). Set timezone_offset_hours to your local UTC offset (e.g. 5.5 for IST, -5 for EST).

instagram_reels._facebook_page_id_note: Sci-fi Nerds Facebook Page ID — enables automatic Reel mirroring to Facebook Page.
